title: Zauner’s dimension-six MUB conjecture
statement: Zauner’s dimension-six MUB conjecture · 1999. Zauner conjectured that at most three mutually unbiased bases exist in \(\mathbb C^6\) (author’s history).

counterexample.description: Four 6×6 bases over one cyclotomic field, scaled so every column has squared norm 6, with every cross-basis inner product having squared modulus 6. Exact power-basis arithmetic directly verifies four MUBs.
